Priya (Growth): Need a one-sheet cheat-sheet for enterprise prospects that AEs can hand in the first convo + link from webinar follow-ups. Focus: security, SLA snippet, and quick deploy guidance (hosted/dedicated/private). Keep it printable as a single page.
Omar (AE): Can we add a 2-line discovery prompt for AEs? Helps qualify hosted vs dedicated.
Sofia (Content): Drafting a micro-hero + 3 bullets now, will paste below.
Sofia (Content): ```
Hero: Production LLMs, secured and SLA-backed.
Bullets:
• Security-first: KMS/HSM, SOC2 audit logs, RBAC + key rotation notes
• SLA snapshot: p99 availability target; Dedicated throughput SLAs; fallback to hosted variant
• Deployment options: Hosted API, Reserved Dedicated, Private VPC/on-prem
```
Liam (PM): Add a one-line latency vs cost callout and a tiny ascii flow for the visual.
Noah (Bench): Benchmark blurb suggestion (single line): "Bench highlight: Dedicated peak ~8k tokens/sec; median token latency ~8ms; p95 ~120ms at 1k qps. Full report: https://bench.redwood/enterprise"
Sofia (Content): AE discovery prompt (2 lines): "Data residency region? Required p95/p99 latency? Expected qps and burst?" Keeping it short.
Omar (AE): Good. Also add a 1-line inbound routing rule for SDRs: "If <150ms p99 or residency requirement -> route to AE for Dedicated discussion; otherwise nurture via self-serve + webinar."
Priya (Growth): Footer line idea for differentiation: "Unified runtime & telemetry — deploy where you need it, operate consistently everywhere."
Liam (PM): SLA phrasing tweak: "p99 availability target. Dedicated customers receive throughput SLAs; automated fallback to compatible hosted models under capacity pressure."
Sofia (Content): Latency vs cost one-liner: "Dedicated pools for low p99 latency; hosted + quantization and async batching for cost-optimized workloads."
deploy-bot: Preview generated: https://redwood-internal.preview/cheatsheet/1945678901 (PDF + PNG) :white_check_mark:
Priya (Growth): Please drop single-line approvals by EOD. Omar, Liam?
Omar (AE): Approved. Minor nit: move Security bullet to the top (done).
Liam (PM): Approved.
Sofia (Content): Final PDF exported and uploaded to the webinar assets folder. Linking in the follow-up emails.
Priya (Growth): Thanks team — closing thread. Will use this as AE quick-hit and webinar follow-up attachment.
